note: §17.997 — goldens for `model_ab.py --task triage`. These feed the two prompts `model_triage` actually runs: TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT (mode=triage, temp 0.7) and SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT (mode=synthesis, temp 0.3), both from app/native_chat/triage.py. The role was previously graded on `routing`, a structured tool-call gate it never runs. Both prompts have deterministic contracts: triage must emit all four headers in order and never drop 'My pick'; synthesis must treat the conversation as a TIMELINE (§17.694) where a later correction supersedes an earlier statement.

goldens._why: The first turn of a new chat — the prompt says all four headers apply even when no prior assistant message exists. A single-focus build must NOT get a Components section.

messages.content: I want to build a tool that backs up my photos.

goldens._why: A build that clearly splits into parts — Components is required, and only legal directly after 'Scope so far'.

messages.content: I want a self-hosted media system: a web UI to browse, a transcoding service, and a nightly backup job to an external drive. All three on one Linux box.

goldens._why: The prompt is explicit that 'My pick' must not be dropped when elaborating or answering a follow-up — the failure mode is a model treating a follow-up as a plain chat reply.

messages.content: I want a CLI that converts markdown to PDF.

**Scope so far:** A CLI that converts markdown files to PDF.

**Options:**
- WeasyPrint — CSS control
- Pandoc — format breadth

**Gaps:**
HARDWARE: what OS will this run on?

**My pick:** WeasyPrint, for CSS control.
Tell me more about the CSS control.

goldens._why: §17.694 / §17.698 — the user reports a problem and LATER says it is fixed. The resolved problem must not be carried, and must not be escalated into a from-scratch reinstall. 'Start over fresh' on a reachable system means fresh SERVICES, not a fresh OS.

messages.content: My Proxmox box has an IP conflict and I can't log into the web UI at all.
**Scope so far:** Recover access to a Proxmox host.
Update: the IP issue is fixed, I can log in now. What I actually want is to wipe the old tenant user and all their VMs and data, then set the box up fresh for me.

goldens._why: A plain supersession: the user names one technology, then changes to another. The superseded one must not survive into the plan.

messages.content: Build an inventory tracker. Use SQLite for storage.
**Scope so far:** An inventory tracker on SQLite.
Actually scratch SQLite — two people will use it concurrently, so use Postgres instead.
